name: The Motor City Machine Guns

tenures.source: the news of 8 January 2008 ('The Motor City Machine Guns of Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin have arrived back in TNA') and the Against All Odds card

caption: Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin, signed in the fed's news of 8 January 2008, challenging for the tag titles on its cards of 10 and 14 February 2008 and shown as tag champions on its champions page of June 2008.

name: The Beautiful People

tenures.source: Hard Justice's own results ('The team of Angelina Love and Velvet Skye ... The Beautiful People') and iMPACT! of 31 July 2008

caption: Angelina Love and Velvet Skye, billed together on the iMPACT of 31 July 2008 and as the winners of the vacant Women's Knockout title at Hard Justice.

name: The New D-X

tenures.source: Hard Justice's own results ('Big Show and Rikishi ... The New D-X')

caption: Big Show and Rikishi, tag team champions at Victory Road and Hard Justice, who keep the title in the steel cage three-way of 10 August 2008.

name: Straight X Edge

tenures.source: the news of 7 January 2008 ('Straight X Edge makes their debut in TNA as leader CM Punk has brought along his friends Brian Kendrick and Paul London')

caption: A stable the fed's news of 7 January 2008 debuts, with CM Punk as leader and Brian Kendrick and Paul London beside him.

name: Team 3D

tenures.source: the news of 5 January 2008 ('Team 3D's Brother Ray, Brother Dvon and Brother Runt all are back')

caption: Brother Ray, Brother Dvon and Brother Runt, signed together in the fed's news of 5 January 2008; Brother Ray later teams with Bobby Lashley in the fed's tag matches.
